export async function mapPool(values, limit, operation) {
 let next = 0;
 await Promise.all(Array.from({length: limit}, async () => {
  while (next < values.length) {
   const index = next++;
   await operation(values[index]);
  }
 }));
}
async function escape(values, limit, operation) {
 let next = 0;
 await Promise.all(Array.from({length: limit}, async () => {
  while (next < values.length) {
   const index = next++;
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
   await operation(values[index]);
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
   await audit(index);
  }
 }));
}
